notes.title: Delta 0: Triple Versions!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38974762/55ac7584ed8e966071458cf12bb2461c4ee755b0.png[/img]

The main "negative" feedback I received was that menus were confusing so I created 2 new versions (Delta 0 and Delta Zero) with label/text for each icon. I also kept the original version so when you launch the game, there are 3 options:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38974762/8faa1363487c643036bce084e2d18f1e82208922.png[/img]

Thanks and have fun,

JS
